description: Create a customer or sub-customer. Accepts name parts, contact info, addresses, and hierarchy settings. Use parent_ref to create sub-customers or jobs. Returns customer details and a link to view in QuickBooks.

bill_with_parent.description: If true, invoices for this sub-customer are billed to the parent (default: false)

display_name.description: Primary display name (must be unique in QuickBooks)

draft.description: If true, validate and show preview without creating (default: true)

job.description: Mark this customer as a job (default: false). Jobs track work for a parent customer.

parent_ref.description: Parent customer name or ID to create a sub-customer or job. Will be looked up to get ID.

preferred_delivery_method.description: How invoices are delivered: Print, Email, or None

sales_term_ref.description: Default payment terms name (e.g., 'Net 30'). Will be looked up to get ID.

ship_address.description: Shipping address (optional, same shape as bill_address)

name: create_customer
